canonical_project: LDI - Landesbetrieb Daten und Information (Landesrechenzentrum RLP) Mainz
notes: LDI (Landesbetrieb Daten und Information), Valenciaplatz 6, 55118 Mainz, is the central IT/digitalisation service provider of Rhineland-Palatinate and operates the state data centre (historically Landesrechenzentrum Rheinland-Pfalz in Mainz, confirmed by Computerwoche). Official state operator page = A. Government data centre; capacity MW not published.
